risk-of-bias.support-for-judgement:
"The lists were generated using standard block randomization methods,

implemented with computer software (nQuery Advisor, 2014, Statistical Solutions, Boston, MA). The randomized numbers from the algorithm correspond to one of the five study arms. While they appeared to be random numbers, they coded for the group assignment. Each of the five study arms had three to four codes so that patterns could not be identified by investigators, coordinators, and staff at study sites"

Uneven medical de-enrolment from study, appears that placebo group are "healthier" suggest some baseline imbalance. Bias in favour of placebo (reduced effect size of iron)

Not explicitly stated that participants and personnel were blinded to allocation, but use of placebo, and pre-packaging of tablets suggests they were blinded.

Due to the expectation that people were blinded, likely will not impact outcomes.
